messages:
samir: Heads up: saw a sudden bump in p95 for /v1/embeddings-stream at 11:07. p50 steady, p99 barely moved. Not sure if routing or telemetry.

natalie: I noticed that too. It coincides with the quota fallback flip for several tenants.

hao: Can you paste the console query? There are multiple percentile pipelines (realtime tdigest vs exact) so need to be careful.

samir: Query: `env:prod service:embed endpoint:/v1/embeddings-stream | percentile(latency_ms,50,95,99) by endpoint, route`. Shows combined p95 went from 120ms -> 210ms.

metrics-bot: Alert: endpoint /v1/embeddings-stream p95 > 180ms at 2026-06-02 11:08:12 — samples 410 (5m).

ryan: Quick theory: small fraction of traffic routed to fallback variant with cold KV cache would lift mid-tail but p99 might remain dominated by main variant long tail.

natalie: I split by route/variant and included counts: main p95=130ms count=388, fallback p95=490ms count=22, combined p95=150ms. Weird that combined in console shows 210ms — might be which aggregation window or rollup the dashboard uses.

hao: Exactly — realtime dashboard uses tdigest rollups aggregated in the ingestion tier; historical console queries default to exact aggregation for the last hour. Comparing them without noting the aggregator is a common gotcha.

samir: So we have two separate issues: 1) small noisy cohorts can materially change combined p95; 2) different aggregation paths make numbers diverge between views. Both cause confusion during rollouts.

ryan: UX recommendations: show per-variant pcts and sample_count in the rollout card, plus a confidence indicator (e.g., "low sample" icon) when sample < 50 or fraction < 5%.

natalie: Ops ask: surface a small "fallback fraction" metric on the endpoint tile so oncall doesn't have to run a custom query. Also include top-3 contributing routes with counts in alert payload.

hao: Telemetry note: we should document tdigest vs exact and show which view uses which method. Also add an endpoint-level flag in the API to request the raw histogram (if available) so we can recompute percentiles consistently for investigations.

samir: Action items: 1) Natalie to add fallback_fraction tile to the endpoint dashboard (small UI change) 2) Hao to update telemetry README and add an API flag for raw-histogram fetch 3) Ryan to prototype per-variant percentile rows + sample_count + CI badge.

natalie: I'll open the dashboard PR and add a short tooltip explaining "cohort influence" and link to a runbook. ETA EOD.

hao: I'll add the README note and a short code example showing how to compute influence: run combined_p95 - p95_excluding_small_routes(% threshold).

ryan: For the CI badge, I'll use Wilson score for low counts and show a hover with numeric CI range. Prototype in #eng-platform later today.

metrics-bot: Tip: include the sample_count and aggregator type in all percentile tiles to avoid mistaken comparisons.

samir: Great. Once PRs land let's test during the next canary weight bump. Thanks all :thumbsup:

metrics-bot: Follow-up reminder: tag telemetry + eng-platform on PRs so docs, API and UI remain consistent.
